description: Status and summary for one run: progress while running; score, severity counts, and links once completed. Adds pollAfterSeconds and, while running, a rough etaSeconds. Scans typically take 2-5 minutes. Best for: recovering when a blocking index365_start_scan call was cut off client-side, or checking an older run. Not for: findings (index365_get_report first, then index365_list_findings). Common mistake: starting a new scan while this one is still running. Example: index365_get_scan_status({ runId: '<uuid>' }). Next: index365_get_report once status is completed.
name: index365_get_scan_status
title: Get scan status
